dedupe_keys.name: dasnordicslr northern europe sea level projections 2020 2150

description: The German Federal Maritime and Hydrographic Agency publishes DASNordicSLR, a regional relative sea-level projection series for northern Europe. It combines IPCC AR6 scenario sea-level change with a Nordic land-uplift model. The article describes decadal values from 2020 to 2150 across 49–75 degrees north and 0–50 degrees east, for five SSP scenarios and 107 uncertainty quantiles. BSH's public Atom feed lists five NetCDF scenario files and CC BY 4.0 terms, with no access restriction or price. The dataset can supply future water-level boundary conditions for coastal flood, port, transport and flood-defence simulations. It is a projected relative mean sea-level change, not a storm-surge event catalogue or a design flood height by itself; surge, tide, waves and local datum must be combined separately. Its land-motion component assumes a constant rate through 2150. The BSH DOI landing had a certificate or gateway error in this review, while its official feed and climate-service documentation remained readable. This resource complements data-era5-reanalysis, which provides atmospheric forcing, not sea-level scenarios. No NetCDF was downloaded.
